# LearnBase — Design Notes

## Source
- ColorLib: Ezuca (https://colorlib.com/wp/template/ezuca/)
- Preview: https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/ezuca/

## Section order
1. Top Bar (email, Register/Login)
2. Navbar (logo, nav links, search)
3. Hero Slider (Swiper, centered text, bg images, "read more")
4. Features Row (5 items, icons, read more links)
5. Featured Courses Horizontal (2 cards: image, title, author, ratings, cost)
6. About Section (3 instructor profiles)
7. Testimonials (Swiper carousel)
8. Featured Courses Vertical (category tabs + course grid)
9. Latest News & Events
10. Home Gallery (image grid)
11. Footer (columns, newsletter, social, Component Dock)

## Tokens
- Primary: #19c880 (green) | Secondary: #f3a90b (gold)
- Text: #383749 (dark) | Muted: #757686, #c0c1cd
- Light bg: #f7f7f7 | Font: Roboto
- Buttons: 10px radius | Avatars: 50%
